pll_rule: EHXPLLL static settings: dividers minus one and CPHASE/FPHASE as nextpnr writes them; internal FEEDBK_PATH selects CLKINTFB, external feedback output found by tracing the CLKFB route; outputs follow Fout = Fin x CLKFB_DIV x Dfb / (CLKI_DIV x Dout) with phase relative to the feedback output and an assumed 50% duty; LOCK high from the start and static output enables override ENCLK (HC05 on the board); reference period learnt from two rising edges; RST/STDBY act only where enabled and hold outputs and LOCK low, outputs restart on their phase grid and LOCK rises 98 304 phase-detector periods plus feedback latency and an acquisition time after the fall (HC07; the board's slow restart ramp is not modelled); dynamic phase and REFCLK bypass not executed
